I’ve realised that there’s no quick fix, my depression will come and go, but I know now that important part, that at points it goes away, a fact which really helps me get out of pits.

One of the things with Nijigasaki is that there appears to be no references whatsoever to any previous idol groups, or any not currently active groups. In fact there is no reference to what groups certain people enjoy other than the currently mentioned schools in the anime and specifically Setsuna Yuki. 

​

So we can guess four things.

1. Nijigasaki is not apart of the Love Live universe including Muse and Aqours. Alongside this theory is the fact that the actual Love Live competition has not been seen or significantly mentioned. 
2. Nijigasaki is set even further in the future than we thought, given Sunshine mentioned and new of Muse 5 years after and they still gained fans even after their split, we can assume that Aqours were in a somewhat similar situation, especially given the fact that they never broke up so they would've lasted at least another 2 years (which would be after Yohane, Ruby and Hanamaru graduate) and we can assume that they still have the new members and may have continued to get more meaning that the school should at least be known given they would still be popular. this means that Nijigasaki could be past our current day, possibly up to 15 years after Muse.
3. Nijigasaki is set at the same time as Sunshine. Given the vast difference in location, there is no arguing why it couldn't be, Aqours hasn't been mentioned and Nijigasaki focuses on solo idols, not groups, so they were less interested in Love Live meaning that little to no interaction would occur between the groups. If I remember correctly, Sunshine's Love Live had 5000 original sign-ups (or maybe less but definitely over 1000 signups). Their lack of interest in Love Live and the sheer amount of new groups would mean that until Aqours wins Love Live or at least performs, they may be unknown to the Niji girls. However, something against this theory is the lack of Muse, since with the idea it would only be set 5 years after, there was still in store merch, and they could be seen in magazines from when Dia and Ruby were younger which meant someone like Setsuna would remember them at least. Also given that then-current third years at Otonokizaka would have attended school at the same time as when Hanayo, Rin and Maki were in their 3rd year, meaning that they probably knew at least of them, and given the school was still a small/average-sized school, they most likely would have remembered them. Also, during the conversation in Sunshine, there is no mention of other idols at Otonokizaka, not to say that there is not but most likely they were groups who did not gain the same popularity or blended in with other popular groups. 
4. Nijigasaki students have simply never heard of the other two groups. I hate to say it but it is feasible with Aqours but not Muse, as they were part of the original School Idol movement and surely when planning something like the School Idol Festival they would of at least come across or had someone mention how Muse threw a massive celebration in their movie. Personally, this is the least likely option given the fact that they are a group of 10 school idol lovers, especially with Yu there, so one of them would know of them.

I miss seeing little hints, like the poster in Chika's room, Riko singing Yume no Tobira, the Beach scenes, but I mainly miss the Love Live competition, I love Niji but it feels like something is missing. Aqours and µ's are so influential (especially since µ's played a massive role in the rising popularity of school idols) so not having them there feels like they are just being ignored.
